title: New Update
message:
• Refreshed colors and overall app look for a cleaner, more cohesive visual experience.
• Redesigned Home and Discovery screens with updated layouts for smoother browsing.
• Redesigned the Search screen for a cleaner layout and easier discovery.
• Smart offline downloads that reuse streamed audio instead of re-downloading from scratch.
• Direct playback from saved offline tracks with zero extra mobile data usage.
• Fixed display and layout glitches across the app for a smoother experience.
